external_collaboration.evidence_quote: This initiative involved the purchase of three show steers, which were later processed into over 2,000 pounds of beef for donation to the Second Harvest Food Bank of Middle Tennessee. This effort not only provides high-quality, nutrient-rich beef to those in need but also rewards the hard work of young cattle producers in the state.
